description: Read-only XRPL Automated Market Maker (AMM) state lookup for a specific pool. Identify the pool with `amm_account`, or with the paired `asset` and `asset2` currency objects; `account` is optional context used by the native AMM lookup when applicable. Use `ledger_hash` or `ledger_index` to pin the lookup to a specific ledger. The result returns native `amm_info` data including pool balances, LP token supply, trading fee, auction slot, and vote slots when present. This paid lookup does not modify the ledger and is subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for AMM pool state; use n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers for DEX order-book depth and n9t2_xrpl_get_ledger_data for raw ledger-state objects.

account.description: Optional XRPL account used by the native AMM lookup when applicable.
account.title: Account

amm_account.description: Optional AMM account address identifying the specific AMM ledger object.
amm_account.title: Amm Account

asset.description: First AMM asset specification using an XRPL currency object.
asset.title: Asset

asset2.description: Second AMM asset specification paired with asset.
asset2.title: Asset2

ledger_hash.description: Optional ledger hash used to pin the AMM lookup to a specific ledger.
ledger_hash.title: Ledger Hash

ledger_index.description: Optional ledger index or selector used to pin the lookup to a specific ledger.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

name: n9t2_xrpl_get_amm_info
